headline: St. Lawrence tops the Liberty with twelve wins
dek: St. Lawrence added four draws and three defeats across the season, winning more matches than any other program in the conference. The program scored 34 goals across all matches while conceding fifteen, finishing atop the table after a campaign built on defensive control.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring volume did not settle the table: Union (N.Y.) produced 44 goals across all matches, more than RPI and RIT combined, yet finished in the bottom half after conceding 24 and taking eight losses alongside nine wins and two draws.

wire.line: Liberty programs won 49 non-conference matches with thirteen draws and twenty losses, scoring 154 goals and conceding 79.

findings.text: St. Lawrence goalkeeper Zach Amato posted an 0.863 save percentage, making 69 saves while allowing eleven goals across the season.
